visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with a goatee and short black hair, wearing a white t-shirt, sits comfortably on a gray fabric couch. White subtitles appear at the bottom center. (2) The scene cuts to a woman with curly hair outdoors on a sunlit city street, enjoying a white and yellow ice cream cone. She closes her eyes as she tastes it, conveying a sense of happiness. In the background, there is historic stone architecture under bright daylight. (3) A slow-motion close-up shows a single drop of water falling into a dark pool, creating concentric ripples on the surface. (4) The camera returns to the man on the couch, who is now holding a baseball. He tosses it slightly and continues his speech with an expressive face, emphasizing his points with his right hand. (5) A still photo-like insert shows a young couple on a beach at sunset; the man carries the woman on his back, both laughing joyfully. (6) Back in the living room, the man finishes his talk, looking directly at the viewer with a sincere expression while holding the baseball.
